text:
maya: Heads-up — incoming pen test for Sprint Alpha next week. We need to confirm KMS gating for the evidence pipeline and ephemeral RBAC windows. Can ops own scheduling with the test team?

alex: +1. Who's the primary contact at the assessor side? Need to lock the retest window and map exact roles we give.

maya: Contact is oliver (RedTeam). Proposed retest slot: Tue 2024-05-14 09:00-12:00 PT. Requirements I want: ephemeral role creation (TTL 2h), KMS proxy tunnel restricted to assessor IPs, and a presigned upload-only endpoint for artifacts.

jamie: We can do ephemeral via STS assume-role. Plan: idp -> STS assume-role with DurationSeconds=7200. Minimal terraform snippet I can share in the ticket. Also add a no-rotation blackout window on host keys.

sam: On logging: SIEM needs to ingest KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt, sts:AssumeRole, s3:GetObject/PutObject events. Retention for this engagement should be 90 days. Add token-usage and policy-change alerts.

maya: Drafting an intake playbook. Minimal checklist: 1) attested contact from assessor, 2) approved JIRA and sprint board card, 3) ephemeral role + TTL doc, 4) presigned evidence upload enabled (write-only), 5) KMS envelope encryption to our customer KMS, 6) SIEM forwarding + retention.

alex: Can we automate the evidence shipper to re-encrypt into the evidence KMS and attach metadata? I can add a small lambda to pull completed presigned uploads and do envelope encrypt. Example encrypt command: 
``
aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/pt-evidence --plaintext fileb://artifact.tgz --output text --query CiphertextBlob
``
Will tag objects with `pt:job=alpha` and `assessor=oliver`.

maya: Also: we require a signed attestation from RedTeam for any exploit artifacts before we accept them into triage. No attestation -> reject and request re-upload.

ops-bot: AUTOCREATE: jira PT-4821 'Sprint Alpha pen test — intake & kms gating' created and assigned to maya. Due 2024-05-10.

jamie: Ops question — if we rotate the PT key mid-window we break reproducibility. Suggest a blackout: no KMS key rotations 09:00-13:00 PT on retest day. I'll add that to runbook.

sam: I'll add a SIEM rule and paging: if key policy changes or kms:DisableKey, page sec-oncall immediately. Also add an alert on anomalous assume-role from non-whitelisted IPs.

maya: Action items: alex -> stand up evidence shipper (deadline Fri), jamie -> publish ephemeral role + terraform snippet and blackout rule, sam -> update SIEM rules/retention, maya -> finalize intake call with RedTeam, upload attestation template to PT-4821.

alex: ack. Will post terraform + lambda skeleton in PT-4821 by EOD.

ops-bot: Scheduled retest window: 2024-05-14 09:00-12:00 PT. Reminder will be sent 24h prior.

maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
